source.author: Kenney
source.note: The plan's own source (Kenney Space Kit `craft_speederA.glb`), fetched with the same sha256-pinned kit zip as the rover. Of the kit's four speeders, A was chosen after rendering A-D in the lab: a low wedge with a long canopy down the nose and swept wings, longer than it is wide; B is boxy, C is a flat 7:5 span-to-length wing, D is a stubbier A with canted winglets. Turned 180 degrees (`ingest.yaw`) so the nose faces +Z; bottom on y = 0 (films lift it to hover). Real size: a single-seat craft about 6.5 m long; height 2.5 m to the canopy fairing makes it 6.56 m long with a 6.25 m wingspan. Noon script, as the rover (indigo was tried: its only dark shade, sky #1b2d6b, nearly merges with the ink on the underside and engines): wings and lower hull cream (`moon`) over paper (`sky`), upper hull and fins vermilion (`accent`) over dark brown (`iris`), engine pods paper over dark brown, canopy flat dark brown (`iris` both tones: the script has no dark shade lighter than ink). Kept faceted (`smooth: false`), 280 tris. Static, no clips.
